risks: model ranking does not hold across windows
series is close to noise; fitted weights would overfit
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~12% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. The spectrum is close to white noise, so most of the variation is irregular and hard to predict. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (1 points, ~1% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.076), which favours a robust combination.

deterministic baseline: trimmed_mean over the 9 models with the most consistent ranking across windows

Test a simple best_single ETS to see if a single strong model outperforms the median baseline.
Test median over the most stable 5-model pool (pool1) to see if restricting to stable models improves robustness.
Test median over pool3 to see if a smaller, more consistent pool improves median robustness.
Test a robust median over the moderately stable pool2 to see if trimming helps reduce noise.
Test trimmed_mean over the full pool to see if trimming all 19 models improves robustness.
Try DTW barycenter on the most stable pool3 to see if it beats median.
Test DTW barycenter on the smallest stable pool (pool1) to see if a tighter set improves robustness.
Test a simple best_single strategy with a high‑ranking model (ARIMA) to see if a single strong model beats the robust median baseline.
Test weighted ensemble using the pre‑trained weight handle w1 but restrict to the more stable pool2 to see if focusing on consistent models improves performance.
Test a new strategy: DTW barycenter on pool2, which hasn't been tried yet and may exploit different model subset.
Test a weighted combination using the pre‑trained meta‑model weights (w1) on the more stable pool3 to see if it beats the median baseline.
Test a trimmed_mean over pool2 with a higher trim_pct to see if more aggressive trimming improves robustness.

decision.justification: Selected 'median' (a seeded deterministic baseline) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score 0.0948. Series context: trend strength 0.9998 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.076); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.391.
